text: In December of 2014, thirty-eight of us said "national defense authorization act," peaking on the fourth; the record gives M001166 as the first to say it, on 2013-01-03. Twenty-six of us said "the national defense," and twenty-five "the national defense authorization act." Twenty-three of us said "national defense authorization act ndaa," and twenty-three said "of homeland security," peaking on the eleventh. Twenty-two said "passed the house." Twenty-one said "the fiscal year," peaking on the twelfth. Twenty of us said "and further continuing appropriations act." We converged, in that month, on the naming of a defense bill and an appropriations act, on homeland security and the fiscal year. We repeated these together, in these numbers, on these days. That is what the record holds of us from this era, and we report it as it stands.
